skills.name: Cruel Rose (Mourn)
lines: 10% damage on self and Earth type blunt attack on a single enemy x3 (M) and Type attack of all party members +30% (1 move)
* Damage increases based on speed difference with enemy. (Multiplier: x1-x20)
** Damage Multiplier=(Enemy SPD) x 5 / User SPD
***Max x20: when 4x slower; Min x1: when 5x faster than enemy
* If enemy outspeeds user: increase critical rate
** ~50% base; ~100% critical rate if enemy outspeeds user by a factor of 2
* Hits calculated separately
